pageIntroduction: An overview of my professional experience, qualifications and development across civil engineering, construction project management, BIM and project controls.
lead: I am a Civil Engineer with experience in major infrastructure, building construction, project controls and site delivery. I have since developed further expertise in construction project management and BIM through postgraduate study and professional engagement in the United Kingdom.
profile: My experience includes highway infrastructure, educational and hospitality buildings, technical office engineering, section engineering and project coordination. At Julius Berger Nigeria Plc, I progressed from Technical Office Engineer to Section Engineer on the Abuja-Kaduna-Zaria-Kano Dual Carriageway Reconstruction Project. I later completed an MSc in Construction Project Management with Building Information Modelling at Northumbria University with Distinction. My current interests include project controls, digital construction, practical industry-academia collaboration and the use of technology to support better project delivery.
